title: Record one four-entry n=8 parity prefix at 3/2 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

For the `n = 8` symbol `(1, 1/8, 1/8, 1/8, 1/8, 0, 0, 0)`, every proper prefix has infinity norm at most `3/2`. The largest is `3/2`. The right shear alone is `647/512`, and the next four proper prefixes are `11/8`. This is the four-entry step left open by #4706. The branch is from fetched main `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`.

The tail `l1` is `1/2`. The schedule applies the right shear, then the even child, then the Schur child, then the left shear, and repeats that order inside every child. There are 22 factors and 21 proper prefixes. The quotient is `(1/8, 7/64, -15/512, -41/4096)`. The first prefix's bottom row sums to `1 + 1/8 + 7/64 + 15/512 = 647/512`. The even child's right shear, with entry `1/8`, lifts the next four proper prefixes to `11/8`. The even grandchild's left shear then lifts the running product to `3/2`, and the remaining 16 proper prefixes stay there. The product of the 22 factors equals the even/odd reordering of the Toeplitz matrix.

`647/512 < 11/8 < 3/2 < 9/4`. This is the first symbol in this chain whose proper prefixes take a value strictly between the opening shear and the one-level cap. The even child is `(1, 1/8, 1/8, 0)`. The Schur child is `(1, 7/64, 49/512, -41/4096)`. Nine nontrivial factors sit in the proper prefixes.

This is one symbol. It does not bound every tail of `l1` at most `1/2`, the generator-shear compiler, the completed Gaussian stage, or the dyadic `p^100` normalizer. No new κ. The selected record is `60403/20000000`.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/triangular-parity-four-entry`
- [x] Prints `PASS_TRIANGULAR_PARITY_FOUR_ENTRY` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetches at 2026-10-22T19:49:42Z and the pre-submit fetch at 2026-10-22T19:53:53Z were that commit. The pinned blobs of `certificates/selected-result.json` (`c35482cd9035843b15a634cc8276a7e1e40e8395`), `GAUSSIAN.md` (`adfb28c93e6b06178c901caaac39ede41a9e541b`), and `vendor/SHALLOW-TOEPLITZ.md` (`bc4349b2daea548ffa09e1f38a31f1df86b0b7be`) were unchanged. κ remains `60403/20000000`.

Prepared by James Reed with substantial Cursor Grok 4.7 assistance.
